pr.title: Qualify Economics M6, SekI scopes and learning-goal book
pr.head: codex/economics-m6-ci-2026-10-10
pr.body:
Economics now has a locally verified M6 checkpoint for all 346 current curricularAtomic goals. The central report covers 2136/2136 original source goals with zero unsupported assignments; its freshness check and protected maturity floors pass. Economics is included as the fifth regular learning-goal book.

The changes resolve the observed CI failures through independently reviewed Economics view metadata, qualified source and stage boundaries, and two Economics test-contract updates. Thirteen country-specific Sek-I views are qualified; the actual native projections contain 79 Brandenburg and 59 Berlin target goals, with all other 30 country/duration target sets preserved. Selected partial source bindings remain explicitly partial. No production runtime, checker or quality threshold is changed.

Validation at `43461b906438572f4f3b64d056112f4189dca4f4`:
- Local native central status/freshness/floors, current memory checks, affected backend tests, composition/source checks, duration-policy followers and documentation checks pass.
- All five native book builds, original-source checks and publication checks pass. The final build reused five current caches; Economics has 346 goal pages.
- Independent final memory review confirms 422 required target/scope pairs with no missing visible or target deck owners.
- Mathematics 807/807 and Physics 478/478 remain M7. Nineteen actual foreign curriculum report rows and 20 whole canonical files are unchanged; the shared parent has only two derived Economics partial-count followers.
- GitHub CI for this final head is pending. The preceding `fbde16db` CI failed in Curriculum QS and Backend; its six other main jobs and Gemini checks passed. That earlier run is preserved, not claimed as final-head acceptance.

[Local checkpoint and bound native receipts](https://github.com/enpasos/skillpilot/blob/43461b906438572f4f3b64d056112f4189dca4f4/curricula/DE/Gymnasium/quality/goal-evidence/2026-10-10/wirtschaft-CI-current-head-source-view-and-test-contract-root-v1/16-final-qualified-current-M6-native-checkpoint-GITHUB-PENDING.ROOT.receipt.json).

Economics M7 remains open: strict 0/346, D216/P346/A346/M346/V0; CQR-303 fails. This package adds zero new scientific strict completions and restores zero strict bindings (net 0). Historical failures and whole before/after inputs are retained; the large native parity output is transported losslessly as gzip. Human review, release approval and trials remain separate, and all current positive profiles retain their truthful AI-candidate/E1/needs-human-review status. No new images or publication is included.
